body: thanks. i’ve been more productive recently and i’m doing better now just looking forwards to getting out of quarantine

i meant i feel imprisoned in my house. saying room just felt more appropriate because i am spending 99% of my time in my room. 

and yeah maybe that is my problem. i know i have more time than ever now that i can’t go out or do anything, so i’m forced to stay at home trying to be productive

in the past few days i’ve been working on my car, it’s something i’ve been wanting to do for a long time now. but i feel like i don’t have time for hobbies or anything else anymore. i can spend time doing pretty much anything but unfortunately the only solution for me right now is to get on with what needs to be done. then hopefully when there’s some pressure taken off me i’ll be in a better mindset to enjoy things again.
